assessment: The primary audience that will be keenly interested in these findings will be those with an interest in T cell development and thymic function, however given the broad applicability of transendothelial migration, there will also likely be broader interest in these findings. The work provides key new insights as to the role of the CD47-SIRPa signaling axis in the regulation of how hematopoietic progenitors enter into the thymus to initiate T cell development.
